# ScooterShop Perth

> ScooterShop is a licensed motorcycle and scooter dealer and repair workshop in Dianella, Perth, Western Australia. The business sells new and used scooters and motorcycles, provides workshop servicing, and offers motorcycle and scooter hire.

ScooterShop has more than 30 years of motorcycle and scooter industry experience. The workshop supports petrol and electric models.

## Main Navigation

- [ScooterShop homepage](https://www.scootershop.com.au/): Motorcycle and scooter sales, workshop services and hire in Perth.
- [Servicing](https://www.scootershop.com.au/service): Motorcycle and scooter workshop servicing, repairs and online booking.
- [Hire](https://www.scootershop.com.au/hire): Current motorcycle and scooter hire availability and booking information.
- [New scooters](https://www.scootershop.com.au/inventory/scooters/new): Current new scooter inventory.
- [Used scooters](https://www.scootershop.com.au/inventory/scooters/used): Current pre-owned scooters and mopeds.
- [Used motorcycles](https://www.scootershop.com.au/inventory/motorcycles/used): Current pre-owned motorcycle inventory.
- [E-Scooters](https://www.scootershop.com.au/escooters): Electric kick scooters sold online when stock is available.
- [Contact](https://www.scootershop.com.au/contact): Address, telephone, email, opening hours and directions.

## Articles

- [Buying a Used Scooter in Perth 2026](https://www.scootershop.com.au/blog/buying-used-scooter-perth): What to inspect, which brands to consider, PPSR checks and private-market warning signs.
- [Car vs Scooter in Perth: The Real Costs 2026](https://www.scootershop.com.au/blog/car-vs-scooter-perth-commuter-guide): Annual commuting costs for cars, petrol scooters, electric mopeds and motorcycles in Perth.
- [E-Scooter Laws in WA 2026](https://www.scootershop.com.au/blog/wa-e-scooter-laws-2026): WA speed limits, permitted riding areas, helmet rules and safety requirements.
- [WA Scooter and Motorcycle Licence Guide 2026](https://www.scootershop.com.au/blog/wa-scooter-motorcycle-licence-guide): WA licence requirements from qualifying mopeds through to unrestricted motorcycles.
